simple.summary: חַשְׁמַן (chashman) means wealthy First listed occurrence: Ps 68 32.

definitions.full: H2831. chashman [ חַשְׁמַן ] noun masculine only plural חַשְׁמַגִּים Psa 68:32 ; meaning unknown, ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ambassadors , Rabb nobles , conjectures from context; doubtless text error; Nes JBL 1891, 152 proposes בשׁמנים they shall come with oils, ointments , Hilg Che (after Aq Jerome) חָשִׁם hasting .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (probably meaning firm or capacious in resources); apparently
